historic_status.reason: No evaluation and 45 years or older

hook: A 1914 cottage standing above a high retaining wall on the south side of Innes.

building.builder: Wilmer W. and Hilda A. Wilson

historic_survey.finding: Appears ineligible for the California Register and the National Register — not closely connected to the families of the boat-building industry and not architecturally significant — but one of the oldest dwellings in the neighbourhood and warranting special consideration in local planning
historic_survey.note: Recorded as the Wilmer and Hilda Wilson Residence and built by day labour; the report's narrative instead calls it the Jorgensen cottage. A one-story hipped-roof cottage clad in California novelty siding, standing on a high scored concrete retaining wall with a stair up from the pavement. The survey names no architect.

historical_record.description: The front of the cottage was reconfigured.
